supported_claims: US Treasury yields bear-steepened on Oct 19, 2026: 2Y rose 6.78 bps to 4.774%, 5Y rose 6.98 bps to 4.938%, 10Y rose 6.48 bps to 5.140% (15:00 EDT print 5.135%), and 30Y rose 4.75 bps to 5.470%, while NAHB Housing Market Index fell 3 points to 29 (lowest since June 2012).

Goldman Sachs Prime Brokerage reported hedge funds sold tech stocks at the fastest pace in at least 10 years over the 5 trading days ended Oct 15, lowering net leverage to a 1-year low of 48.6% while tech still represents 23.5% of Prime holdings (90th percentile).

NYMEX WTI settled down -0.79% at 8.24/bbl and USO fell -0.59% to 60.81 on Iraq oil export recovery (3.40 mb/d) and CLX26 expiry, but late-night escalation (Israeli PM Netanyahu ordering IDF/Mossad to prepare to overthrow the Iranian regime and Saudi Arabia postponing FII to 2027) drove China INE SC crude night session up +2.34% to 735.60 RMB/bbl.
Spot gold fell -0.60% to ,140.52/oz (Asian morning ,135.69/oz) after touching a record high of ,183.50/oz, COMEX gold settled at ,160.30/oz (-0.50%), and GLD closed at 79.69 (-0.61%).

At the 2026 Financial Street Forum on Oct 19, PBOC Governor Pan Gongsheng announced a non-bank institutional large-redemption liquidity support tool and CSRC Chairman Wu Qing approved the first batch of 18 actively managed ETFs.

action_conclusions.B: B. 今天仅应挂条件的候选：idea_20261016_02 多 IH2611 / 空 IM2611（若此前未建仓，待今日 09:30 开盘后中证 1000 受外盘科技带动反抽、使 50/1000 现货比价回踩 0.4150–0.4170 且 IM2611 年化贴水差 ≤ 8.0% 时按 5手:3手挂单，止损 < 0.4050）；idea_20261017_01 原油看涨价差（待今日 CLX26 交割出清、今晚 21:30 美股开盘确认 WTI 12月合约 CLZ26 企稳 ≥ 8.50 时挂单买入 USO Dec 2026 60/78 Call Spread 且要求净权利金 ≤ .80/股，或今日 09:00 内盘 SC 守稳 725 元、FU2612 守稳 5,550 元时轻仓配置多 FU2612 / 空 L2701）；idea_20261016_04 黄金看涨价差（趁 GLD 回落至 79.69，今晚 21:30 美股开盘挂单询价 GLD 2027年1月 80/10 Call Spread，要求净权利金 ≤ .00/股）。
action_conclusions.C: C. 今天继续观察：若此前已按条件建仓则继续持有 idea_20261016_01（多 50% TSM + 50% MSFT / 空 SOXX，今晚 21:30 观察比价站稳 0.8400 的加仓窗口）、idea_20261016_02（多 IH2611 / 空 IM2611）与 idea_20261016_03（桐昆股份 601233.SH）；今日 09:00 中国 10 月 LPR 报价、10:00 国新办工信部前三季度发布会及首批 18 只主动 ETF 发行进展；内盘纯碱（SA）去库相对焦煤（JM）创两月新低的黑链强弱分化及天然橡胶（RU/NR）保税区七连降正套机会。
action_conclusions.D: D. 今天必须回避或若此前已建仓则有条件退出：严禁在今日（2026-10-20）正式到期交割的 NYMEX WTI 11月合约（CLX26）上保留任何敞口或新开仓；在美债 10Y 收益率跃升至 5.140% 且现货金回落至 ,135–,140 的背景下，严禁追高单边无保护的贵金属期货及 A 股黄金/白银矿企股（中金黄金 600489.SH、昨日跌超 5% 的盛达资源 000603.SZ）；严禁趁隔夜美股存储反弹追高 Q3 单季净利环比骤降 35%–49% 的 A 股存储模组股（江波龙 301308.SZ）；若此前已按条件建仓且触及止损线（idea_20261016_01 净值回撤达 -4.0% 或 TSM < 07.13、idea_20261016_02 比价 < 0.4050、idea_20261016_03 桐昆股份跌破 18.10 元），则严格执行有条件退出。
